schema:
CREATE TABLE coins (
  category,
  date_added,
  date_launched,
  description,
  id,
  name,
  notice,
  platform_id,
  slug,
  status,
  subreddit,
  symbol,
  tag_names,
  tags,
  website
);

CREATE TABLE historical (
  circulating_supply,
  close,
  cmc_rank,
  coin_id,
  date,
  high,
  low,
  market_cap,
  max_supply,
  num_market_pairs,
  open,
  percent_change_1h,
  percent_change_24h,
  percent_change_7d,
  price,
  time_high,
  time_low,
  total_supply,
  volume_24h
);
